text:
morgan: idea: add a right-rail "Invoices Quick Access" that slides out on desktop and appears from bottom as a sheet on mobile. keeps header uncluttered but gives a persistent place for downloads. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/right-rail-invoices viv: nice for discoverability. concern: right-rail could push table content left and hide columns. maybe make it overlay with a dimmer, or a slim rail that expands on click. ash: finance still wants per-project download visible. suggestion: tiny PDF icon at row end + right-rail for bulk + status. on mobile put per-row download inside accordion. lia: accessibility: if the rail is a panel, ensure role="region" and aria-label="Invoices Quick Access". toggle button needs aria-expanded and aria-controls. If the panel is modal-like, trap focus; if not, ensure logical tab order. aria-live region for exports:
Export started for 2 invoices...
. Non-color cues for status badges required. morgan: copy nit: rename row header from "Tokens" to "Token usage". show cost helper: "$0.0008 / token (avg)". also show invoice status pill (Paid / Pending / Processing) next to download. viv: UX variants for experiment: A = slim right-rail (overlay) + visible per-row PDF icon (hover desktop, icon inside kebab mobile); B = header Export only + right-rail accessible via small link in header + per-row in kebab. Metrics: time-to-download, support tickets "where is my invoice", percent of per-row vs bulk exports. run 10 days. ash: toggle idea: allow users to pin the rail so it stays open; remember via local storage or account setting. also keyboard shortcut for focused row -> press D to download invoice. if we add shortcut, check conflicts with assistive tech. lia: aria examples: row button: . panel toggle: figma-bot: Uploaded frame "Right-rail Invoices (overlay & pinned)" (desktop/mobile). prototype: https://www.figma.com/proto/right-rail morgan: action items: viv + ash to mock both variants in figma by Wed, include pinned/unpinned states and mobile sheet. lia will queue a11y passes (VoiceOver & NVDA) once prototype is live. we'll evaluate metrics after experiment and pick default. :thumbsup:
